chars.SALAH: SALAH: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans with white sneakers.
chars.SOUHAILA: SOUHAILA: a young woman wearing a long emerald-green dress with a thin gold belt and a cream-colored headscarf.
chars.ABDO: ABDO: a tall man wearing a black leather jacket over a white t-shirt, a silver chain and black trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest modern Moroccan apartment bedroom in Temara. SOUHAILA, annoyed and limping with a bandaged foot, walks toward the door with her bag, glaring back at SALAH. SALAH sits on the edge of the bed staring suspiciously at her smartphone, which lies glowing on the bed sheet between them. Open tension between the two.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close view of a smartphone lying on a messy bed with a patterned Moroccan blanket, its screen brightly lit and glowing in the dim bedroom, a short video playing on it (blurred colorful shapes, no readable text).

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan apartment living room with a sedari sofa, SALAH and SOUHAILA argue angrily face to face, she points a finger at him, he throws his hands up in frustration.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the bedroom, SALAH alone slowly picks up the glowing smartphone from the bed with both hands, looking at it nervously, the bedroom door in the background is half open and empty.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A memory scene in a narrow Moroccan neighborhood street at dusk: ABDO leans confidently on a wall while SOUHAILA laughs shyly next to him, the two clearly flirting.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the dim bedroom, SALAH sits on the bed holding the smartphone close to his face with wide shocked eyes and an open mouth, the phone screen lighting his face green.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Comic scene: SALAH stands in the bedroom with a pair of big grey cartoon donkey ears on his head, face-palming himself with one mitten hand, holding the phone in the other hand, embarrassed.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: SALAH sits frozen on the bed staring at the phone in disbelief; behind him a large ghostly translucent image of ABDO appears smirking, like a thought in his mind.
